name: RSK Group
note: UK environmental, engineering and technical services group (RSK Group Limited, 03761340, Helsby, Cheshire); Charlton's sole front-of-shirt sponsor for men's and women's first teams since 2025/26, renewed for 2026-27 (rskgroup.com). Companies House PSC: Alan Ryder Investments Limited (25-50% of shares and voting rights), itself 75%+ owned by RSK founder and CEO Dr Alasdair Alan Ryder. RSK also took a £500m preferred equity investment from a Searchlight Capital Partners-led consortium with Ares Management (June 2024, RSK announcement, rskgroup.com/news/rsk-welcomes-strategic-investment/); preferred equity, no ordinary-share control disclosed. No record evidence found. Propose: none.
